title: MathsGrove official-spec alignment brief — first original tier upgrade
principle: Syllabus and examples inform scope/level, not text reuse. Questions and working below must be independently authored, mathematically checked and approved by a human examiner before students see them.

sources.note: Core and Extended; a dedicated non-calculator paper at each tier for 2025–2027, and explicit communication/reasoning
Keep Pure, Mechanics and Statistics routes distinguished; 2026–2027 content includes quadratics, functions and probability/statistics
Explicit AO1 techniques, AO2 communicating/reasoning, AO3 context and connections; Higher uses more AO2/AO3 than Foundation
Maintain distinctions between AA/AI and SL/HL, 2029 first-assessment revisions must not be applied to current examination cohorts
Two papers of 20 multiple-choice items, Paper 1 application and Paper 2 reasoning; overall score not a direct percentage

first_cycle: Four academic routes: GCSE Foundation (AQA), GCSE Higher (AQA), IGCSE Extended (Cambridge), A Level AS (Cambridge).
Each academic route receives one original Daily skill check, one Weekly multi-step application and one Exam integrated reasoning draft.
All 12 items stay in private Supabase editorial stage and are never automatically inserted as active practice.
Persist original question source, four unique answer choices, one keyed correct response, clear worked rationale, common wrong-method cues, approximate timing and tier/level/board.
Question-bank multiple choice is currently one mark in the task marking system; full multi-mark rubric functionality needs separate authoring and assessment implementation.
Later cycles should address GCSE Higher/noncalculator, Cambridge IGCSE Core, Pearson IGCSE 4MA1, IB AA/AI SL/HL, Further Maths and TMUA without mixing incompatible syllabuses.

tier_guidance.daily: Single transferable micro-skill plus explanation of working; short, accessible and purposeful, 2–5 minutes
tier_guidance.weekly: At least two linked steps with an explicit modelling or reasoning decision and check, ~6–9 minutes
tier_guidance.exam: Integrated multi-step problem; include justification, suitable domain/restrictions and credible distractors; do not falsely label short practice as a full mock

QA_rules: exactly four distinct plausible choices and one correct choice
prompt unambiguous and final outcome agrees with worked derivation
all fractions/surds/inequalities shown with KaTeX-compatible inline notation
correct positive solutions and realistic units
prevent copyright copying and misleading official-board endorsement
level suitability and calculator status explicitly checked
editorial draft not public or active, even after a successful deployment
